top_reviews.title: Amazing! New favorite
top_reviews.body: Love this suit! Bought it for a spa day and it was perfect. I have a hard time with bottoms riding up but these ones stayed put so well! The top has great support (and I have a larger chest). The gathering in the sides is very flattering. It had all the benefits of wearing a two piece but the coverage of a one piece. The top didn’t do anything weird and billow out in the pool. Bert comfortable all day! I will probably be getting this in more colors! And the price was so amazing for what good quality it is!

top_reviews.title: Get it girl!
top_reviews.body: Flattering & Comfortable Bathing Suit! I absolutely love this two-piece! The high-waisted bottoms give great support and full coverage, which makes me feel comfortable and confident. The top is really cute with the ruching detail and buttons — stylish without sacrificing comfort. I could honestly wear this every day to the pool! Overall, it’s a flattering, well-made suit that I’d definitely recommend. Great buy!

top_reviews.title: A summer must get!
top_reviews.body: This is my favorite bathing suit ever! It is so cute and really good quality. The material is thick and stretchy and holds its shape really well. I got the green one and it is so flattering! I’ve had mine for over a year and it is still just as good quality as it was when I bought it.
